description: Defines the TransferStats class in the GuzzleHttp namespace, representing transfer data after an HTTP request, including request/response objects, transfer time, handler stats, and errors.

classes.name: TransferStats
classes.description: A class that encapsulates data related to an HTTP transfer, such as request and response objects, transfer time, handler statistics, and error data.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a TransferStats object with the provided request, response, transfer time, handler error data, and handler statistics.

methods.name: getRequest
methods.description: Returns the request object associated with this transfer.

methods.name: getResponse
methods.description: Returns the response object if available.

methods.name: hasResponse
methods.description: Indicates whether a response was received.

methods.name: getHandlerErrorData
methods.description: Retrieves handler-specific error data, which could be an exception, error code, or other data.

methods.name: getEffectiveUri
methods.description: Returns the URI to which the request was sent.

methods.name: getTransferTime
methods.description: Retrieves the estimated transfer time in seconds.

methods.name: getHandlerStats
methods.description: Returns an array of handler-specific transfer statistics.

methods.name: getHandlerStat
methods.description: Retrieves a specific handler statistic by name.
